description: This file implements the DataReaderV1 class, which reads metadata and data segments (audio/video) from a buffer for a media pipeline, specifically version 1 of the data format.

classes.name: DataReaderV1
classes.description: A class responsible for reading metadata and media segments from a buffer, supporting version 1 of the data format.

methods.name: DataReaderV1
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DataReaderV1 with media source type, buffer, metadata offset, and number of frames.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads and returns media segments (audio or video) based on the metadata.

methods.name: readMetadata
methods.description: Reads and returns a vector of metadata structures from the buffer.
